meridian.rule: N copies of the figure on planes through its vertical median, turned by 180/N deg each (p24: 180 deg suffices)
meridian.limit: the swept outline is a CONE: apex at the holding sphere's pole (b = R), base circle radius R*sqrt3/2 at b = -R/2 (latitude -30)
meridian.N2: hull of 2 copies at 90 deg = a square pyramid: base diagonal = side S, base side S/sqrt2, height S*sqrt3/2; face slant/half-base = sqrt7 = 2.646 (not phi)
meridian.sphere_touch: the cone meets the holding sphere only at the pole and along the latitude -30 circle
meridian.closure: from an eye on the equator at a copy's azimuth only that copy closes; a copy turned by t opens by 0.151 (5 deg), 0.596 (20), 1.259 (45) of its own size (wf6/levels q_ladder_closure)

bands.rule: B = F(k) latitude bands of equal height 2R/B (Archimedes: equal area); each band a ring of figures alternating upright and point-reflected (the ladder's opening rule), each figure as tall as its band's arc; 2*round(2 pi R cos(lat)/S) per band
bands.count_rule: B = the largest Fibonacci number with 2R/B >= the leaf's height (1.886 blocks): bands never finer than the leaf, so the facets never vanish at any size

golden_spiral.rule: N = F(k) figures at z_i = 1-(2i+1)/N, longitude i * golden angle: equal area each; its visible spirals run in consecutive Fibonacci counts

head.rule: the circle turned about a diameter (p24): ray-cast, exactly round

cube.A_tribar: Ay (0,0,0)->(0,1,0), Ax ->(1,1,0), Az ->(1,1,1): three edges of the unit cube, ends a cube diagonal apart = the line of sight
cube.reading: the impossible joint is the cube's main diagonal seen end on; the cube is each tribar's hidden solid; a cube is 6 such paths (the 6 orders of x, y, z), which use all 12 edges
